TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Sulu Sea
DATE 12 October 2028 · 0640 local
SIDE Philippine Navy
WINDOW 110 min, closes at 165
HTMS Chakri Naruebet. Photo: PH3 ALEX C. WITTE, USN · Public domain · cropped

SULU SEA, 0640. MV PALAWAN PIONEER and MT PRINCESA STAR sailed from Honda Bay at first light with the Balabac outpost's stores and fuel. They are the season's first convoy down the Sulu side of Palawan, and the only one this month. The outpost has eleven days of diesel left.

Two Meridian fast attack craft left Cagayancillo before dawn and are running north-west at speed. Meridian calls them escorts. One of them fired on BRP Kagitingan off Tubbataha in September. A trawler with no nets out has been keeping station on the convoy since it cleared the bay.

Bring both ships into the head of the Balabac lane, thirty miles south-west. Your ships are weapons Free. Nothing is rearmed after today: what you fire comes back only from a supply ship you own, alongside, at eight knots or less.
Fishing bancas and the Puerto Princesa-Cuyo ferry are on the water. Identify before you fire.
Naval Forces West, Puerto Princesa
COMMANDER'S INTENT

The outpost at Balabac lives on this road. Bring both ships into the head of the lane. The Meridian boats are armed and have fired on a Navy patrol boat before; if they close the convoy, stop them. What your ships fire today they will not get back until a supply ship gives it to them, so fire what the job needs.
• Bring the convoy into the head of the Balabac lane
• Lose neither convoy ship
• Sink the Meridian boats if they close
• Harm no banca, ferry or airliner

Your task group, with its helicopter if one is embarked and any supply ship you bought. Convoy: MV Palawan Pioneer and MT Princesa Star. Opposing: two Meridian fast attack craft and a trawler keeping company. Neutral: bancas and the Cuyo ferry. Puerto Princesa's field is open to your aircraft.

The planned window is 110 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 55 minutes more; the operation is closed at 165 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
